name: banded_lines
description: bands of fine parallel lines sweeping through and around the set: hair-fine equipotential lines at an even spacing, a second family crossing them in a hatch, each escape band its own shade over a dark ramp, the set a pale hair along their spine
reuses: the palette layer by rank on the inverted smooth count, at a gamma of 2.4: a dark ramp that lifts only far from the set
a period sheet at one escape step on the smooth count, multiplied: a shade per escape band (the references' hard-edged bands)

rank sheets of the smooth count (the sheet layer's `bands` at frame rank), here at 220 and 420 bands with no fill and a narrow rim: hairlines along the equipotentials, screened light and multiplied dark
flame_veil_blue's `view` (turned 30°, zoom 0.9) on a third rank sheet at 160 bands: a second family of equipotentials crossing the first
glow_filaments' falloff glows on de: a halo and a pale hair along the set
the tone pass, at the reference's median and p10
notes: Round one's keeps (item 045): teal at julia-multibrot4_364f02ea and the glints formulation (rose) at julia-mandelbrot_ac9b1000; no rose locations and no cobalt, so banded_lines_cobalt left the library. Matt, score 2: okay to keep but not great; the banding is mostly too high frequency. No round two.

The look, refined from the three references (forbidden-borders and echoes-of-the-mind, -25.jpg, signed exoteric.roach.org, and fractal_abstraction_lines): fine parallel lines gathered into bands, each band a sweep of evenly spaced hairlines that bends with the structure; two families crossing at a shallow angle so their crossings glint (forbidden-borders' periwinkle hatch over maroon and navy arcs), coarsened into broad alternating stripes in echoes-of-the-mind's teal and gold, and fanned off a white spine on black in abstraction_lines' cobalt. The lines carry the vibe; the ground is a dark ramp and the band shade.

Added: nothing new to the engine. The lines are the set's own equipotentials, cut by a sheet at **frame rank** (`bands`, not `period`): a `period` on the raw smooth count crowds without bound into the set and aliases to grey mush at a draft, while equal-rank cuts space the lines by area, so they stay a few pixels apart everywhere and still bend round every filament. The crossing family is the same cut through a turned `view`. Palette entries, one per reference (banded_lines_rose the default from forbidden-borders; _teal from echoes-of-the-mind: 90 filled bands for broad stripes and a stronger band shade, tone 0.458/0.165; _cobalt from abstraction_lines: the ramp not inverted, so the set is the bright spine and the far field black, tone 0.1/0.0 against the reference's 0.0 median, which a tone curve cannot reach).

Lessons (round one, item 043): **the field-lines channel does not carry a deep seat**: `lines` at radius 2 on a gallery Julia seat drew fine hatch only in the outermost band and noise everywhere nearer the set, and `divide` 2 flattened it to tone (crescent_lines' finding, met again). **The stripe average's level lines read as scribble, not bands**, through a crossing view. **A rank sheet on a view at few bands (9) draws soft blobs**, wide translucent shapes over the set; the bright glints are a period sheet on the frame's own count instead (the `glints` formulation). The scout's thin seats (`--max-ink 0.10`, phoenix left out: a phoenix draft costs minutes) gave 22 of 40, half of them spirals, dropped by eye.
